subject: Inter-team rating synchronization — session playbook & tolerance thresholds
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Inter-team rating synchronization — session playbook & tolerance thresholds

Hi all,

We need to run a short, structured anchoring session next week to tighten cross-team rating variance ahead of final bands. Goal is to reduce inter-team drift and agree on a tolerance window for mid-and-senior ICs so we minimize appeals.

What's attached: a seed workbook with anonymized sample ratings + a one-page session agenda. Key asks before the session:
- Review the "seed" tab and flag any rows you think reflect inconsistent anchors (comment in-sheet).
- Come prepared with two anonymized examples (one conservative, one aggressive) that we can use as group anchors.
- Confirm whether your team is comfortable with +/- 0.25 band tolerance for L4–L6 or if we need a stricter rule.

Proposed format (45 minutes): 10m framing -> 20m anchor alignment (3 examples) -> 10m tolerance decision -> 5m next steps. We will anonymize names in the workbook during the meeting.

I'll draft a short facilitation playbook and a mutual action plan during the meeting. LMK availability Tue/Wed next week.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Director, People Programs
Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks for this. Quick reads:
- I reviewed the seed workbook and left comments on 7 rows where calibration historically diverged between Eng and Product.
- My ask: include a one-slide reminder on how we handle cross-functional impact (e.g., product-embedded engineers) so reviewers apply the same lens.
- I can do Tue 10:00–11:00 or Wed 09:30–10:30. Preference for Tue.

One suggestion on tolerance: for L5 (senior IC) let's keep +/-0.2 instead of 0.25 — we've seen small swings cascade in stack ranking. Happy to justify with historical distributions during the session.

+1 to Tue. I reviewed the seed set and added two rows that I think are outliers because of unusual comp cycles in Q3. For the facilitation playbook, can we add a hard rule: when teams disagree and the variance is >0.5, we escalate to the cross-functional panel (TCB) instead of averaging? That avoids middle-ground compromises that under-index calibration.

Also — can we anonymize org and role tags? In the workbook some rows still show "Platform / Staff Eng" which primes reviewers. Remove role-level hints unless necessary.

Subject: Inter-team rating synchronization — final session playbook & mutual action plan (Tue 2026-09-22 10:00 PT)

Team —

Thanks for the fast reviews and the comments in the sheet. Final plan attached and below is the mutual action plan we will run in the 45-minute session. We are recording for audit and will redact any PII before storing. I also looped in PeopleOps Consulting to observe facilitation and confirm our tolerance thresholds map to fairness checks.

Session logistics:
- When: Tue 2026-09-22 10:00–10:45 PT (Zoom link on calendar).
- Facilitator: Tessa. Notetaker: Laura (please capture JIRA ticket IDs next to exceptions).
- Recording: Yes (will be stored in HR audits folder with redaction).

Playbook (step-by-step):
1) Framing (10m): review goals, rules of the room (no name-calling, focus on evidence: impact, scope, outcomes).
2) Anchoring (20m): present 3 anonymized examples (we will use the ones in the "seed" tab). Each example: 3m to present, 3m to debate, 1m decision. Capture vote and rationale.
3) Tolerance decision (10m): agree tolerance per level. Current proposal: L4 & L6 +/-0.25; L5 +/-0.20.
4) Exception protocol (5m): Variance >0.5 -> escalate to cross-functional panel (TCB) with documented rationale and two supporting work samples.

Mutual action items before session (owners):
- All: sanitize seed workbook and comment on rows by EOD Mon (everyone).
- Laura: prepare slide on cross-functional impact lens + be notetaker (owner: laura_bennett).
- Marcus: create JIRA template for exceptions and pre-create ticket HS- (owner: marcus_lin).
- Vivek: validate that variance >0.5 escalation flow aligns with existing appeals SOP (owner: vivek_kulkarni).
- Tessa: run the session and publish the playbook + anonymized record by Fri.

Attachments: session_agenda.pdf, anonymized_examples.docx, interteam_ratings_seed.xlsx (redacted copy will be posted after the session).

If no objections I will lock the tolerance thresholds post-session and circulate an FAQ for managers.

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

Tessa
Director, People Programs
Redwood Inference
